{{Icon|Nature Amp icon|'''Nature Amp'''}} is a type of buff applied to operators in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When operators are affected by '''Nature Amp''', they temporarily deal more {{Color|Nature DMG|5}}. The number represents the degree of increase.

Multiple sources of Nature Amp, as well as {{G|Arts Amp}} stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Amp Multiplier''' for that damage instance. The resulting Amp Mulitplier stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
